security_spec.violation_condition: When no entries are delegated to SPMP (mpmpdeleg.pmpnum equals total implemented PMP entries), the CSR access decoder raises an illegal instruction exception upon access to SPMP-related registers (siselect/sireg/sireg2 or miselect/mireg/mireg2 targeting SPMP entries), instead of silently returning zero on reads and ignoring writes.
security_spec.summary: PR changes disabled-SPMP CSR access behavior from 'raise illegal instruction exception' to 'reads return zero, writes ignored' — RTL CSR decode logic must not trap on SPMP CSR accesses when no entries are delegated
